sourcePrompt: Four-second vertical front-camera iPhone video in a parked car. A young adult white woman with a light-brown bob sits facing the phone, wearing a lavender zip hoodie over a white top. The camera is close and level with her face, cropping from upper chest to just above her head; the seat and bright side window remain visible behind her. She looks directly into the lens with a focused, slightly incredulous expression. Her free hand rises beside her temple with fingers loosely spread, holds there for a beat, then lowers a few inches as her eyebrows lift and a small smile appears. One natural gesture, normal speed, realistic mixed daylight and car shade. No speech, captions, or dramatic reaction.
